init.title: PERMEAR options
init.description: Attention, delivery and cycle settings, in that order — the AI providers sit at the end; you normally never touch them. Saving reloads the integration, no restart needed.

data.sensitivity: How much the house tells you

data_description.sensitivity: The only attention knob. Quieter means fewer events reach you; the emit threshold self-regulates inside the band you pick.
data_description.daily_briefing_delivery: The morning summary of the previous day. Turning it off stops the message only — the nightly cycle keeps running and keeps feeding memory, priorities and restrictions. The weekly summary is sent either way.
data_description.telegram_chat_id: Optional. Leave empty to use the first chat allowed by the Telegram bot.
data_description.primary_resident: The resident PERMEAR centers on. Pick a person from Home Assistant, or type a name for a resident without a person entry.
data_description.agent_name: What the assistant calls itself in conversation. Leave empty for the neutral name (PERMEAR).
data_description.heartbeat_start: Before this time the house stays silent, whatever happens.
data_description.heartbeat_end: After this time the house stays silent again.
data_description.sleep_time: When the day is consolidated into memory. This always runs, even with the daily summary turned off.
data_description.systems_time: When the week is compiled into patterns and suggestions.
data_description.conversation: Conversation agent used for dialogue (with tools).
data_description.data: AI Task entity used by the cycles (gray zone, briefing, weekly compile).
data_description.conversation_fallback: Takes over with tools when the primary conversation provider fails.
data_description.data_fallback: Takes over when the primary data provider fails.
data_description.voice_script: Optional. A service PERMEAR speaks through, e.g. script.my_voice, called with a message variable. Leave empty for no voice — PERMEAR never decides on its own when to speak.

system_log_fire_event.title: PERMEAR error monitor is inactive
system_log_fire_event.description:
The error monitor needs the system_log integration to fire events. Add the following to configuration.yaml and restart:

```yaml
system_log:
  fire_event: true
```

Without it, no error cards will be sent to Telegram.
